prompt:
Redesign TripLOG's transport and accommodation reservation cards as a cohesive passport-pocket UI mockup, improving the empty state while preserving the selected design direction. Show the two cards side by side as one desktop component at approximately 682 by 300 logical pixels. Retain the app's warm cream paper, pale blue transport pocket, pale pink accommodation pocket, dark ink, yellow accents, subtle material texture and small travel illustrations.

Give both cards an identical, balanced structure: one continuous cream paper insert, a top row with a category icon, a single category title and a compact yellow count pill aligned together; a fine divider; a clearly spaced empty-state message; and a substantial yellow add button aligned at the same height on both cards. The count must belong to the header layout rather than float over a pocket edge. Keep the paper seams and illustrations out of all text and button areas. Use compact, readable Korean Pretendard-style typography with deliberate letter spacing, consistent weights and natural line breaks. Keep headings, counts and messages unique, without repeated category text. Preserve enough breathing room without a large unused blank area.

Left card text:
교통 예약
0건
이동 계획을 채워보세요
항공·기차·버스 예약을
한곳에 모아둘 수 있어요
교통 예약 추가

Right card text:
숙소 예약
0건
머무를 곳을 담아보세요
숙소와 체크인 일정을
한눈에 확인할 수 있어요
숙소 예약 추가

Input images:
- Image 1: the user's current implementation screenshot to improve.
- Image 2: the previously selected refined passport-pocket mockup, which remains the design direction.
